findings.defect_1: taxXml.ts had hardcoded fallback mock data (OGRN 1027700132195, Smirnov A.V., license LO-77-01-019842) masking unconfigured clinic profile. Fixed by enforcing real clinic credentials and failing with clear statutory error if missing.
findings.defect_2: patientPortal.ts had hardcoded mock FPD '319841209' and hardcoded relationship 'patient', ignoring payer parameter and netting of refunds. Fixed by extracting real fiscalSign, honoring payer relationship, and normalizing refunds via normalizePaymentsForTaxCertificate.
findings.defect_3: familyFnsTaxService.ts violated Art. 219 Tax Code of RF by multiplying grand total by 0.13 without the 150k/120k Code 1 ceiling, and had broken age heuristic (<24) tagging parents as spouses. Fixed by querying patientRelationships graph and implementing strict Art. 219 ceiling (150k Code 1 cap, Code 2 uncapped).
findings.defect_4: familyTaxBatchEngine.ts emitted empty identity doc tags (<УдЛичнФЛ СерНомДок="" />) and passed un-netted raw payments into certParams. Fixed by omitting empty tag when passport is missing and applying normalizePaymentsForTaxCertificate.
findings.defect_5: fiscalReconciliationStatement.ts suffered from NaN evaluation when shiftRevenueTotalKopecks was undefined. Fixed by summing parsed kopeck values.
findings.defect_6: fiscalReceiptRoutes.ts did not adjust original payment amountRub on partial refund (data.totalRefundKopecks < origKop). Fixed by updating payment amountRub to net remaining balance.
findings.defect_7: TaxDeductionCertificateModal.tsx hardcoded Sberbank INN 7707083893, KPP 770101001, OGRN 1027700132195 and Smirnov mock. Fixed by defaulting to empty strings and normalizing yearPayments.
findings.defect_8: taxDeduction.ts generated empty <Лицензия Номер="" /> when licenseNumber was undefined/empty. Also generated <УдЛичнФЛ КодВидДок="21" СерНомДок="" /> when series/number were empty strings. Fixed by conditional tag inclusion.
findings.defect_9: taxDeduction.ts and familyTaxBatchEngine.ts lacked proper Sole Proprietor (ИП) support: 12-digit INN clinics were forced into <СвМО>/<СвНП> with fake KPP and missing ОГРНИП. Fixed by splitting into ЮЛ (<СвМО ИННЮЛ=... КПП=... ОГРН=...>) and ИП (<СвМО ИННФЛ=... ОГРНИП=...>) without fake KPP.
findings.defect_10: familyTaxBatchEngine.ts generateFnsBatchNoMedoplXml injected hardcoded default KPP 770101001 into clinicId even when clinic.kpp was omitted, causing fileId schema mismatch. Fixed with safeKpp strictly respecting clinic.kpp presence.
